+def _named_event_filtered_out(raw: str, event_names: frozenset[str]) -> bool:
+    event_start = 0
+    if raw.startswith(":"):
+        comment_lf = raw.find("\n")
+        if comment_lf == -1:
+            return False
+        event_start = comment_lf + 1
+    if not raw.startswith("event:", event_start):
+        return False
+    event_lf = raw.find("\n", event_start)
+    if event_lf == -1:
+        event_lf = len(raw)
+    event_end = event_lf - 1 if raw[event_lf - 1] == "\r" else event_lf
+    if raw[event_start + 6] == " ":
+        current_event = raw[event_start + 7 : event_end]
+    else:
+        current_event = raw[event_start + 6 : event_end].strip()
+    return bool(current_event and current_event not in event_names)
+
+

+def parse_sse_text_event(
+    text: str, *, event_names: frozenset[str] | None = None
+) -> SSEEvent | None | object:
+    # SSE uses CR/LF framing; Unicode line separators can occur inside JSON text.
+    event_start = 0
+    raw_prefix = ""
+    if text.startswith(":"):
+        comment_lf = text.find("\n")
+        if comment_lf != -1:
+            comment_end = comment_lf - 1 if text[comment_lf - 1] == "\r" else comment_lf
+            event_start = comment_lf + 1
+            raw_prefix = text[:comment_end] + "\n"
+    if text.startswith("event:", event_start):
+        event_lf = text.find("\n", event_start)
+        data_start = event_lf + 1
+        if event_lf != -1 and text.startswith("data:", data_start):
+            event_end = event_lf - 1 if text[event_lf - 1] == "\r" else event_lf
+            data_lf = text.find("\n", data_start)
+            if data_lf != -1 and text[data_lf + 1 :] in ("\n", "\r\n"):
+                data_end = data_lf - 1 if text[data_lf - 1] == "\r" else data_lf
+                if text[event_start + 6] == " ":
+                    current_event = text[event_start + 7 : event_end]
+                else:
+                    current_event = text[event_start + 6 : event_end].strip()
+                if (
+                    event_names is not None
+                    and current_event
+                    and current_event not in event_names
+                ):
+                    return None
+                json_start = data_start + 5
+                leading_space = json_start < data_end and text[json_start] == " "
+                if leading_space:
+                    json_start += 1
+                    has_data = json_start < data_end
+                else:
+                    has_data = bool(text[json_start:data_end].strip())
+                data: dict[str, Any]
+                try:
+                    if has_data:
+                        parsed, json_end = _JSON_DECODER.raw_decode(text, json_start)
+                        if json_end != data_end and text[json_end:data_end].strip():
+                            raise json.JSONDecodeError("Extra data", text, json_end)
+                    else:
+                        parsed = {}
+                    data = parsed if isinstance(parsed, dict) else {"value": parsed}
+                except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                    if leading_space:
+                        data_text = text[json_start:data_end]
+                    else:
+                        data_text = text[data_start + 5 : data_end].strip()
+                    data = {"raw": data_text}
+                if text.find("\r", 0, data_end) == -1:
+                    raw = text[:data_end]
+                else:
+                    raw = raw_prefix + text[event_start:event_end] + "\n" + text[data_start:data_end]
+                return SSEEvent(current_event, data, raw)
+    return _FAST_PARSE_MISS
+
+
+def parse_sse_text(
+    text: str, *, event_names: frozenset[str] | None = None
+) -> list[SSEEvent]:
+    event = parse_sse_text_event(text, event_names=event_names)
+    if event is _FAST_PARSE_MISS:
+        return parse_sse_lines(re.split(r"\r\n|\r|\n", text), event_names=event_names)
+    if event is None:
+        return []
+    return [event]
+
